# fjordrun_workflow (Resource)

An agentic workflow: a graph of steps, and what starts it. Running a workflow is a one-off action of the API and the dashboard, not part of this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_workflow" "nightly" {
  team_id     = var.team_id
  name        = "nightly-report"
  description = "Runs at 03:00, and on a call to its webhook"

  definition = jsonencode({
    nodes = [
      { id = "trigger", type = "trigger", name = "Trigger", config = {}, position = { x = 80, y = 160 } },
    ]
    edges = []
  })

  triggers = [
    { type = "cron", cron = "0 3 * * *" },
    { type = "webhook" },
  ]
}

output "webhook_url" {
  value     = fjordrun_workflow.nightly.webhook_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (1-150 characters).
- `team_id` (String) Team ID.

### Optional

- `definition` (String) The graph as a JSON document with `nodes` and `edges`, typically `jsonencode({ ... })`. Compared by meaning, so formatting and key order are no diff. Defaults to a single trigger node.
- `description` (String) Free text (up to 2000 characters).
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether triggers start runs (default `true`).
- `project_id` (String) Attach the workflow to a project of the team.
- `triggers` (Attributes List) What starts the workflow. Defaults to `manual`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--triggers))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Workflow ID.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) URL that starts a run, if the workflow has a `webhook` trigger. It contains a secret.

<a id="nestedatt--triggers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `triggers`

Optional:

- `cron` (String) Cron expression, for type `cron` only.
- `type` (String) Required: `manual`, `cron`, `webhook` or `api`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# by workflow ID
terraform import fjordrun_workflow.nightly eeeeeeee-eeee-eeee-eeee-eeeeeeeeeeee
```
